scheduling.censoring: first-failure prefixes; missing outcomes remain unmeasured
scheduling.policy: maximum of historical Windows cost and passed observed runtime maxima; not a fit guarantee

provenance.applicability: Historical scheduling only. Later conic, fixture and explicit serial-oracle repairs differ; no current-source numerical qualification or timing bound.

scheduling.timing_semantics: JUnit testcase elapsed, including fixture costs; not process-wall or qualification budget
scheduling.unknown_policy: historical rest_mean fallback is policy for unmeasured nodes, not their measured cost
